blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Goal-conditioned planning with image observations and goals requires predictions that distinguish visual states and action consequences. Spiking neural networks offer sparse computation, but single-step spikes can obscure motion cues and merge actions with different physical outcomes. We propose the Spiking Latent World Model (SpikWM), an end-to-end joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) with one simulation step per image and one neural update per latent position. Spiking Regional Encoding retains spatial cues through regional pooling. Bi-Spike Action Encoding combines positive and negative binary responses, while Causal Membrane Prediction carries subthreshold evidence across the latent history with learned group-wise time constants. The encoder and predictor are trained jointly on reward-free image--action trajectories using next-embedding prediction and SIGReg. With a common planner, SpikWM achieves mean success rates of $88.67\%$, $97.33\%$, $99.33\%$, and $86.67\%$ on Push-T, Two-Room, Reacher, and OGBench-Cube, respectively, outperforming two spiking baselines. Push-T ablations support each module, and controlled replays examine responses to appearance and physical state changes. Under a matched planning budget, SpikWM reduces estimated arithmetic energy by $75.6\%$ relative to LeWM. Code will be released at https://github.com/ShawnYE618/SpikWM.
blocks.zh: 以图像观测和目标为条件进行规划需要预测,以区分视觉状态和行动后果。 斯皮克神经网络提供稀有的计算,但单步突起可以模糊运动提示并用不同的物理结果来将动作合并. 我们提出Spiking Latent World Model(SpikWM),一个端到端的联合嵌入式预测架构(JEPA),每个图像有一个模拟步骤,每个潜在位置有一个神经更新. Spiking区域编码通过区域集合保留了空间提示. Bi-Spike Action Encoding结合了正负二进制响应,而Causal Membrane Pregency则携带了潜伏历史的下限证据,并带有有学识的分组时间常数. 编码器和预测器使用下嵌的预测和SIGREG,共同接受无奖励图像动作轨迹的培训. SpikWM拥有一个共同的规划师,其成功率分别为88.67美元、97.33美元、99.33美元和86.67美元,分别超过了两个振幅基线。 Push-T活化支持每个模块,受控重放检查对外观和物理状态变化的反应. 根据相应的规划预算,SpikWM将估计的算术能比LeWM减少75.6美元. 将在https://github.com/ShawnYE618/SpikWM发布代码.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Goal-conditioned planning from images requires choosing actions that lead to a desired state specified by a goal image. Reaching a target object pose requires anticipating how successive contacts change its position and orientation. World models (WMs) learn these action-dependent dynamics from experience, enabling agents to evaluate candidate plans before acting [ 18 , 17 , 22 ] . To make this evaluation tractable, latent WMs predict in a compact representation space without reconstructing future images [ 43 , 27 , 20 ] . Action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn these representations and dynamics from image–action trajectories by predicting future observation embeddings conditioned on preceding observations and actions [ 2 , 20 ] . The planner then rolls out candidate action sequences and ranks their predicted endpoints by distance to the goal embedding, reusing the same dynamics across visual goals. However, this search requires repeated predictions across many candidates and rollout steps, making inference efficiency critical to planning latency and energy consumption.
blocks.zh: 以目标为条件的从图像进行规划,需要选择导致目标图像指定的预期状态的行动. 达到目标对象的姿势需要预测连续接触如何改变其位置和方向。 世界模型从经验中学习这些依赖行动的动态,使代理人能够在采取行动之前评价候选计划[18、17、22]。 要使这种评价具有可操作性,潜伏的WMs在紧凑的表示空间中预测,而不重建未来的图像[43、27、20]。 以行动为条件的联合组合预测结构(JEPAs)通过预测以先前观察和行动为条件的未来观测,从图像-行动轨迹中学习这些表现和动态[2、20]。 规划者随后推出候选行动序列,并按距离将预测终点排到目标嵌入,跨视觉目标重用同样的动态. 然而,这一搜索需要许多候选人反复预测和推出步骤,使推论效率对规划延迟和能源消耗至关重要。

blocks.en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) communicate through sparse, asynchronous spikes and integrate successive inputs through membrane dynamics [ 13 ] . On neuromorphic hardware, this event-driven operation is energy-efficient [ 11 ] , making SNNs a potentially efficient alternative to dense networks for repeated prediction during planning. SNNs already perform competitively on visual tasks, including image classification, detection and segmentation [ 44 , 35 , 34 ] , as well as video recognition [ 45 , 37 ] . Spiking-WM extends the use of SNNs to visual control, following Dreamer in using imagined rollouts to train a policy that maximizes task reward [ 28 ] . However, using spiking latent world models for goal-conditioned planning remains largely unexplored. In this setting, the planner uses the model at test time to rank candidate action sequences by how closely their predicted outcomes match a supplied goal image. Reliable ranking therefore requires a representation that retains goal-relevant details such as object pose and a predictor that distinguishes the effects of different actions over multiple steps.
blocks.zh: 螺旋神经网络(SNNs)通过稀疏,同步的突起进行通信,并通过膜动力学整合连续输入[13]. 在神经形态硬件上,这种事件驱动的操作是节能的[11],使得SNNs成为了在规划期间重复预测的密集网络的潜在高效替代品. SNN已经在视觉任务上进行了竞争性的表演,包括图像分类,检测和分区[44,35,34],以及视频识别[45,37]. Spiking-WM将SNNs的使用扩展至视觉控制,跟随Dreamer使用想象的推出来训练一种能最大限度地奖励任务的政策[28]. 然而,利用不断涌现的潜在世界模式进行有目标条件的规划,基本上仍未加以探讨。 在此设定中,规划者使用测试时的模型,根据候选动作序列的预测结果与所提供目标图像的匹配程度进行排序. 因此,可靠的排名需要保留与目标有关的细节,如物体姿势,以及区分不同行动对多个步骤的影响的预测器。

blocks.en: Visual SNNs commonly repeat each image over T T simulation steps to accumulate neural responses [ 44 , 33 ] . Extending such multi-step computation to candidate rollouts increases planning cost. We therefore target one simulation step per image and one neural update per latent position. To examine the challenges of this setting, we replace selected continuous activations in LeWM with single-update spiking neurons, yielding Spiking-LeWM. On Push-T, this direct substitution weakens motion-direction readout from visual latents (Fig. 1 a) and maps 300 300 distinct action blocks to only 120 120 predictor conditions (Fig. 1 c). The latter has a concrete planning consequence: two plans differing only in their first action block receive identical forecasts and goal costs, although only one reaches the goal (Fig. 1 b). On fixed action sequences, median fifth-block prediction error is higher with predicted history than with observed history (Sec. 3 ). These findings highlight the central challenge: reducing neural updates while retaining the information needed to distinguish and rank candidate plans .
blocks.zh: 视觉SNNs通常在T T模拟步骤上重复每个图像以积累神经响应[44,33]. 将这种多步骤计算扩大到候选人的推出,增加了规划费用。 因此,我们的目标是每个图像一个模拟步骤和每个潜在位置一个神经更新。 为了审查这种设置的挑战,我们用单更新的尖刺神经元取代了LeWM中选定的连续激活,产生Spiking-LeWM. 在Push-T上,这种直接替代将运动方向读取从视觉潜伏(图1a)中削弱,并将300300个不同的动作块映射到仅120个120个预测器条件(图1c). 后者有一个具体的规划结果:两个计划仅在第一个行动组别中不同,但得到的预测和目标成本相同,尽管只有一个达到目标(图1b)。 在固定的动作序列上,第五块的中位数预测误差在预测历史上高于观测历史(Sec. 3 ). 这些结论突出了中心挑战:减少神经更新,同时保留区分候选人计划并排位所需的信息。

blocks.en: To address this challenge, we propose Spiking Latent World Model (SpikWM), an end-to-end JEPA-style model for goal-conditioned planning. We design visual encoding, action conditioning, and latent prediction to preserve planning-relevant information. Since global pooling can obscure spatial changes, we introduce Spiking Regional Encoding (SRE, ℰ \mathcal{E} ), which assigns channel groups to image regions and pools features within each region. Action conditioning faces a different bottleneck: positive-only thresholds can map distinct action currents to the same silent response. Bi-Spike Action Encoding (BAE, 𝒜 \mathcal{A} ) therefore introduces complementary positive and negative spike streams, combining them through learned readouts to retain these distinctions. Within the predictor, evidence that is insufficient to trigger a spike at one position may still inform later predictions. Causal Membrane Prediction (CMP, 𝒟 \mathcal{D} ) preserves this evidence through membrane integration with learned group-wise time constants, alongside causal spike-driven attention. The resulting model processes each image in one simulation step and performs one neural update per context position. We evaluate planning success on four tasks and examine the proposed designs through ablations and controlled replays.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议采用Spiking Latent World Model(SpikWM),这是符合目标条件规划的JEPA式终到模式。 我们设计视觉编码、动作调节和潜在预测 以保存与规划有关的信息 由于全球集合可以遮蔽空间变化,我们引入Spiking区域编码(SRE, E\mathcal{E}),该编码将频道组指定给图像区域,并在每个区域内集合特征. 动作调节面临不同的瓶颈:只有正数阈值才能将不同的动作流映射到同一个无声响应. Bi-Spike 动作编码( BAE, A \ mathcal{A} ) 因此引入了互补的正向和负向突起流, 通过学习的读取把它们结合起来来保留这些区分 。 在预测器内,不足以在某一位置触发猛增的证据仍可能为以后的预测提供依据。 Causal Membrane Prespect (CMP, D\ mathcal{D}) 通过膜与学习到的分组时间常数的结合,以及因果悬崖驱动的注意来保存这一证据. 由此产生的模型将每个图像在一个模拟步骤中处理,每个上下文位置进行一个神经更新. 我们评价四项任务的规划成功,并通过模拟和控制性重播审查拟议的设计。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as: • We propose SpikWM, to our knowledge the first spiking latent world model for goal-conditioned visual planning. Its efficient architecture uses one simulation step per image and one neural update per context position. • We identify weakened motion cues, action-condition collisions, and errors from imagined histories. Based on these findings, we design SRE, BAE, and CMP. • SpikWM surpasses both spiking baselines on four tasks and many ANN baselines on multiple tasks. Estimated Push-T arithmetic energy is 75.6 % 75.6\% below LeWM’s. Ablations and visualizations reveal distinct responses to appearance and physical state changes.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述为:我们提议SpikWM, 据我们所知,它是第一个以目标为条件进行视觉规划的潜在世界模式。 其高效的架构采用每个图像一个模拟步骤,每个上下文位置一个神经更新. ^ 我们发现了弱化的运动提示 行动条件碰撞 以及想象中的历史错误 基于这些调查结果,我们设计了SRE、BAE和CMP。 · SpikWM既超越了四项任务的快速基线,也超越了多项任务的ANN基线。 估计Push-T算术能量比LeWM低75.6%, 视差和可视化揭示了对外观和物理状态变化的不同反应.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work and Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作和初步情况

blocks.en: 2.1 Latent World Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 后期世界模式

blocks.en: Latent world models learn environment dynamics in a representation space. PlaNet uses observation and reward prediction for planning, while Dreamer learns policies from imagined latent trajectories [ 18 , 17 ] . JEPAs instead predict the representation of a target from an encoded context [ 2 ] . Action-conditioned models extend this formulation to predicting the consequences of commands. DINO-WM and V-JEPA 2-AC learn dynamics on pretrained visual features [ 43 , 3 ] . PLDM and LeWM jointly learn visual representations and dynamics from offline image–action trajectories [ 27 , 20 ] . LeWM uses next-embedding prediction and SIGReg to train without reconstruction, stop-gradient or a target encoder. ALeWM further organizes predictive information into compact latent prefixes [ 1 ] . We use LeWM as the ANN baseline and study the representation and temporal computation needed to construct a spiking model.
blocks.zh: 后期世界模型在代表空间学习环境动态. PlaNet使用观察和奖励预测进行规划,而Dreamer则从想象中的潜在轨迹中学习政策[18,17]. 联合环保局则从编码上下文中预测一个目标的代表性[2]。 有行动条件的模型将这种提法扩展至预测指令的后果. DINO-WM和V-JEPA 2-AC学习预训视觉特征的动态[43,3]. PLDM和LEWM联合从离线图像-动作轨迹[27,20]学习视觉表现和动态. LeWM使用后续嵌入式预测和SIGrag来训练,不进行重建,停止升级或目标编码. ALEWM进一步将预测信息组织为紧凑的潜在前缀[1]. 我们使用LEWM作为ANN的基线,并研究构建闪烁模型所需的表示和时间计算.

blocks.en: 2.2 Spiking Neural Networks
blocks.zh: 2.2 螺旋神经网络

blocks.en: SNNs combine binary events with stateful neuronal dynamics. Surrogate-gradient learning enables optimization through hard firing decisions [ 21 ] , while learnable membrane time constants adapt temporal integration [ 13 ] . Spiking Transformers extend these mechanisms to image recognition and dense prediction through spike-driven attention [ 35 , 34 , 36 ] . Video models further exploit neuronal state across successive frames for sequence processing [ 38 , 45 ] . Alongside these, population-coded control and multi-threshold neurons enrich input representations beyond a single binary threshold [ 29 , 12 , 41 ] . In recognition, encoding and leak can improve corruption tolerance, whereas suppressing high-frequency features can remove useful image detail [ 33 , 14 ] . For planning, the key question is whether such information loss changes the ranking of physical outcomes.
blocks.zh: SNNs将二进制事件与状态神经动力学相结合. 超高阶学习能够通过硬发射决定[21]实现优化,而可学习的膜时间常数则适应时间融合[13]. 弹簧 变形器通过螺旋式驱动的注意将这些机制扩展到图像识别和密集预测[35,34,36]. 视频模型进一步跨越连续帧利用神经态进行序列处理[38,45]. 除此之外,人口编码控制和多阈值神经元丰富了超过单一二进制阈值的输入表示[29,12,41]. 在承认时,编码和泄漏可以提高腐败的容忍度,而压制高频特性则可以删除有用的图像细节[33,14]. 就规划而言,关键问题是这种信息损失是否改变了实际结果的排名。

blocks.en: Spiking Prediction & WMs. Spiking prediction has been explored for video representations, dynamic graphs and images [ 10 , 40 , 16 ] . Earlier spiking planners operate on explicit task states or robot configurations [ 26 , 30 ] , and generative spiking models support discrete visuomotor prediction [ 6 ] . Spiking dynamics have also been used for learning from imagined experience and reward-guided control [ 9 , 7 , 8 ] . Spiking-WM combines a spiking visual encoder and state-space model with reconstruction, reward prediction and policy learning [ 28 ] . SpikeWorld corrects actions of a frozen policy under actuator changes [ 39 ] . We jointly learn visual representations and action-conditioned dynamics from reward-free trajectories, then use the predicted representations directly to score candidate plans for an image goal.

blocks.en: Goal-conditioned planning ranks action sequences by the distance between predicted endpoints and the goal. This ranking can fail when distinct physical outcomes receive identical predictions, or when prediction errors reverse their ordering. We examine how visual encoding, action conditioning, and prediction history cause failures and motivate our design.

blocks.en: Tasks and data. We use LeWM’s offline datasets [ 20 ] for Push-T manipulation [ 43 ] , Two-Room navigation [ 27 ] , Reacher joint-configuration control [ 31 ] , and OGBench-Cube placement [ 23 ] . Training uses four-frame windows sampled five environment steps apart, with each action block containing the intervening commands.
blocks.zh: 任务与数据. 我们使用LEWM的离线数据集[20]进行Push-T操纵[43],双室导航[27],雷彻联合配置控制[31],OGBench-Cube定位[23]. 训练使用四边框窗口对5个环境步骤进行抽样,每个动作区块都包含干扰指令.

blocks.en: Planning protocol. We evaluate each SNN on 50 50 start–goal pairs per task at each of three seeds ( 42 42 , 2026 2026 , 2027 2027 ). Following LeWM’s released protocol, the goal is 25 25 commands after the start and the agent has 50 50 commands to reach it. All three SNNs use CEM with a five-block horizon and squared terminal latent distance. We implement Spiking-LeWM with single-update LIF activations. For Spiking-WM [ 28 ] , we reuse Spiking-LeWM’s visual encoder and add a spiking projection. We widen its DSSM’s deterministic state and hidden layers to 1024 1024 to align parameter scales, using five neural updates per transition. Both adaptations use next-embedding prediction and SIGReg. All local analyses use the final (epoch-ten) checkpoint for each model. Published results retain their source protocols.

blocks.en: Appearance and state. On Reacher and Cube, recoloring increases prediction error less for the spiking models than for LeWM, relative to each model’s clean replay. On Reacher, we change the arm color at step 25 25 while replaying the same actions. Hard thresholds can suppress color changes that leave firing decisions unchanged. A separate Cube rollout tests how accurately the models predict the gripper’s position relative to the cube. The mean error on this rollout is 8.43 8.43 cm for SpikWM and 11.37 11.37 cm for LeWM.
blocks.zh: 观与州. 在Reacher和Cube上,相对于每个模型的干净重播,重彩会增加弹跳模型的预测误差少于LeWM. 在Reacher上,我们在第25步25分改变手臂颜色,同时重播同样的动作. 硬阈值可以抑制色彩变化,使射击决定保持不变. 一个单独的立方体推出测试模型如何准确预测钳手相对于立方体的位置. 这次推出的平均误差为:SpikWM为8.43 cm,LeWM为11.37 11.37 cm.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.3 违约

blocks.en: Figure 4 a reports mean Push-T success. SpikWM achieves 88.67 % 88.67\% with a sample SD of 1.15 % 1.15\% . The Positive only variant retains BAE’s positive stream and achieves 71.33 % 71.33\% (SD 3.06 % 3.06\% ). This is the largest drop, suggesting that both polarities help distinguish pushes. Global pooling replaces the four regional averages with a global average per channel, yielding 75.33 % 75.33\% (SD 2.31 % 2.31\% ). This decrease is consistent with the need to retain pusher–block geometry. The No carry variant resets the FFN membrane at each position while retaining causal attention, yielding 82.67 % 82.67\% (SD 1.15 % 1.15\% ). Each position can still attend to earlier spikes. The six-point drop suggests that carrying subthreshold activity across positions also helps the planner choose a sequence of pushes that moves the block toward its goal pose.
5.4 Predictive Behavior
blocks.zh: 5.4 预测行为

blocks.en: Action-conditioned prediction diversity. For Fig. 4 b, each model receives the same 300 300 action blocks at 12 12 Cube starting contexts. We count distinct predicted latent vectors after the first action block. SpikWM retains 270.33 ± 39.10 270.33\pm 39.10 distinct predictions, compared with 249.33 ± 41.42 249.33\pm 41.42 for Spiking-LeWM and 300 300 for LeWM. SpikWM therefore distinguishes more action candidates than Spiking-LeWM. The count measures action resolution but does not indicate whether each predicted future is physically accurate.
blocks.zh: 具备行动条件的预测多样性。 对于图4b,每个模型在12个立方体起始语境下得到相同的300300个动作块. 我们数了第一个动作区块后 不同的预测潜在载体 SpikWM保留了270.33±39.10270.33\pm 39.10的明显预测值,而Spiking-LeWM的预测值为249.33±41.42249.33\pm 41.42,LeWM为300300. 因此,SpikWM比Spiking-LeWM更能区分动作候选人. 计数测量动作分辨率,但没有说明每个预测的未来在物理上是否准确.

blocks.en: Open-loop forecasts. Figure 3 compares open-loop forecasts from the same observed context and recorded actions. In Push-T, SpikWM keeps the pusher near the T-block’s stem, while both spiking baselines predict different block angles. In Two-Room, it follows the agent into the left room, while Spiking-WM leaves it near the doorway. On Cube, it better preserves the gripper-to-cube relation, though the cube remains slightly lower than recorded. On Reacher, it follows the forearm’s turn toward horizontal, with LeWM giving the closest joint angles.
blocks.zh: 开源预测. 图3比较了从同一观察到的背景和记录的行动中得出的开放预测。 在 Push-T 中, SpikWM 将推手保留在 T 块的干线附近, 而两个尖端的基线预测不同的块角度. 在"双室"中,它跟随代理人进入左室,而Spiking-WM则把它留在门道附近. 在立方体上,虽然立方体仍然略低于记录,但是它还是更好地保留了夹手对立方体的关系. 在Reacher上,它跟随前臂转向水平,LEWM给出最接近的关节角度.

blocks.en: Physical latent probing. We freeze each world model and fit linear and MLP readouts to recover physical state from its embeddings. On Cube, SpikWM has the lowest normalized gripper-position MSE with both readouts: 0.309 0.309 linearly and 0.394 0.394 with the MLP ( Tab. 3 ). The linear result shows that the positional advantage is accessible without a nonlinear decoder. End-effector position provides a useful cue for approaching and placing the cube. The advantage is limited to some properties: Spiking-LeWM has slightly lower MLP cube-position error, and yaw correlations remain weak across the three models.
blocks.zh: 物理潜伏探测 我们冻结每个世界模型 并装配线性读数和MLP读数 从嵌入中恢复物理状态。 在Cube上,SpikWM拥有最低的常态抓取式定位MSE,两个读出:0.309 0.309 线性,0.394 0.394 与 MLP (Tab. 3 ). 线性结果显示,位置优势在没有非线性解码器的情况下可以访问. 最终效果器位置为接近和放置立方体提供了一个有用的提示. 其优势仅限于一些属性: Spiking-LeWM的MLP立方体位置误差略低,而yaw的关联性在三种模型之间仍然很弱.

blocks.en: Visual and state changes. We replay the same actions from 16 16 paired Two-Room starts. At step 50 50 , we either recolor the agent in place or move it to a new position ( Fig. 5 ). Relative to the clean replay at that step, SpikWM’s next-embedding error rises 5.40 5.40 -fold after recoloring and 89.88 89.88 -fold after displacement. Across sampled steps 55–90, its mean recolored-to-clean error ratio is 4.35 4.35 , compared with 44.81 44.81 – 92.12 92.12 for the baselines. Thus the predictor registers the change in position while remaining less sensitive to the agent’s new color over subsequent steps.
blocks.zh: 视觉与状态变化. 我们重播16个16对双室的动作 在第50步50,我们要么重新粉饰到位的特工,要么将其移动到一个新的位置(图5). 相对于该步骤的清洁重播,SpikWM的下一个嵌入错误在重新涂色后上升了5.40倍,在迁移后上升了89.88倍。 在整个抽样步骤55-90中,其平均重彩与清洁误差比为4.35 4.35,而基线为44.81 44.81 – 92.12 92.12。 因此,预测器在记录位置变化的同时,对代理人新颜色的敏感度低于随后的步骤。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced SpikWM, an end-to-end JEPA-style spiking world model for goal-conditioned visual planning. Regional pooling retains spatial cues, two spike streams encode complementary action responses, and membrane carry integrates evidence across latent positions. This design uses one simulation step per image and one neural update per latent position. Mean planning success reaches 88.67 % 88.67\% on Push-T, 97.33 % 97.33\% on Two-Room, 99.33 % 99.33\% on Reacher, and 86.67 % 86.67\% on OGBench-Cube. Both spiking baselines score lower on all four tasks, and each component ablation reduces Push-T success under the same planner.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SpikWM, 一个端到端的JEPA风格的世界模版,用于有目标条件的视觉规划. 区域集合保留了空间提示,两个突起流编码了辅助行动反应,膜承载了跨潜在位置的证据。 这种设计采用每个图像一个模拟步骤,每个潜伏位置一个神经更新. 平均计划成功率在Push-T上达到88.67%,在两室上达到97.33%,在Reacher上达到99.33%,在OGBench-Cube上达到86.67%。 在所有四个任务中,两个尖端基线的得分都较低,每个组件的衰减会减少Push-T在同一计划员下的成功.
